scope: Read-only real-data audit; CPU; no optimization/training or accuracy claim
dataset_relocation_note: Preserve formal subdirectory choices while relocating their data root via --data-root.

issm.mask_convention: 1 = floating/ocean, defined by raw floating[0] < 0; 0 otherwise

anuga.rainfall_units: m/s (ANUGA Rate_operator SI rate, no adapter conversion)
anuga.statistics_scope: All training-split times and nodes, weighted exactly as full adapter force tensors
anuga.normalizer_scope: Force statistics fitted with FeatureNormalizer; dummy static/state arrays unused

anuga_history.sampling_rule: N >= B: B distinct anchors; N < B: all N once plus B-N replacement draws, shuffled per scenario
anuga_history.history_note: K tables use H1 for this structural audit; formal Phase 3 requires the selected Phase-1 H*.
anuga_history.training_sampler_note: Formal totals divide by four without padding; other world sizes use PyTorch DistributedSampler semantics.
